answer: A licensed quartz mirror workshop leases one mirror bench per applicant for 120 days. Each mirror carries a violet dye mark on its edge, so a photo proves it on site. The applicant polishes 12 quartz mirrors in 90 days and logs each weight with a neighbor signature. An inspector visits twice and matches the log to the mirrors on the rack. A forged tally forfeits the 150 token deposit and bars the applicant 180 days. Faking 10,000 workshops freezes 1,500,000 tokens and costs 950,000 dollars. Like a hall of mirrors showing only its bench, a fake identity has nowhere to hide at the count.
